reviewer: Independent stateless Gemini 3.8 Flash audiovisual model request
reviewerType: model perception of actual MP4, not human listening
prompt:
Review the attached final MP4 as an independent viewer of a Polish product demonstration. Watch and listen to the actual supplied video, including its beginning and ending. You have no prior project history, narration script or edit plan. The file lasts 108.000 seconds. Do not invent scenes or times outside that boundary.
Assess the clarity of the story, readable visible UI, whether shown outcomes correspond to narration, Polish voice intelligibility/pronunciation, music level against voice, abrupt edits, black frames, narration or music cutoffs, distracting artifacts and truthful Demo labelling. Check whether the alternative outcome is understandable. Report concrete, observable problems only; distinguish uncertainty and optional taste from actual defects. Do not infer market success or real blockchain deployment. Do not request creative rewrites if the existing sequence works.
Return JSON: coverage with sampled/observed range and limitations, concise scene_outline with times, voice, music, audiovisual_alignment, visual_readability, opening, ending (last spoken words and whether audio completes), confirmed_issues (severity, approximate timestamp, observation, smallest correction), optional_observations, overall_pass. A passing result is allowed. Do not claim a human listened or frame-perfect timing. Assess the actual media, not just a transcript.
